column8: Rust covers source-after-destination merge, duplicate-key last-wins behavior, canonical sorted keys, and serialized scalar/nested values; Go typed key/value conversion and BinaryJSON byte equality remain external.
Rust covers empty-to-NULL output, NULL values, escaped keys, unsigned values, and nested JSON fragments; Go expression evaluation, charset metadata, and full aggregate execution remain external.
Rust covers source state allocation/reset shape and distinct-key replacement; Go swiss-map bucket and per-key/value memory delta accounting remain external.
The source spill round-trip obligation remains explicit at this boundary; Rust covers the underlying ordered map while chunk serialization/deserialization and spill helpers remain external.
